root_idea.summary: The root centers on lowness or inferiority: the lower or inferior part of a thing, and by extension what is base, vile, rejected, or least esteemed.
root_idea.development: The lexical range develops from being or becoming low or inferior to describing bad or rejected things, lowly people, inferior refuse, debased qualities, and the worst or most abject stage of life. Derived forms also express causing or judging something to be low or bad.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized elative citation form أَرْذَلُ; the Quran occurrences include plural and substantivized forms.

senses.definition: The lowliest, basest, or most contemptible people; those regarded as the inferior or rejected members of a group.
senses.usage_conditions: Used substantively in Quranic plural forms for a group of people, as in أَرَاذِلُنا and الأَرْذَلُونَ.

senses.definition: The worst or most abject stage of life: decrepit old age accompanied by dotage and severe loss of former capacity.
senses.usage_conditions: Occurs in the construction أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ, referring to advanced old age in which a person may be reduced to an infant-like state and no longer retain former knowledge or understanding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become low, base, vile, mean, or contemptible; of a thing, to be or become bad, corrupt, abominable, or disapproved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person with respect to appearance, states, or circumstances, and to things generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or pronounce a person low, base, vile, mean, or contemptible, or to judge a thing bad, corrupt, abominable, or disapproved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive; used of declaring money or livestock bad and of rejecting particular men as inferior. The passive participle مَرْذُولٌ denotes what has been so judged or declared bad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have low, base, vile, mean, or contemptible companions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV usage describing the character of one's companions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard, find, or desire a person or thing to be low, base, vile, bad, or disapproved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes a person or thing as its object and expresses deeming or wishing it to be inferior or objectionable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, base, vile, mean, or contemptible person, or a bad, corrupt, base, abominable, or disapproved thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May qualify a person, thing, or garment, including a dirty or inferior garment; numerous plural formations are attested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The worse or vilest of anything; the inferior refuse left after the good has been selected, and, of people, the lower or baser part of mankind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can refer collectively to people as the lower or lowest portion of mankind, or to the inferior remainder of things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, base, vile, mean, contemptible, or bad quality; a vice opposed to a virtue.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Intransitive Form I meanings are represented.
Transitive judgment and rejection meaning is represented.
Form IV companion usage is represented.
Pointer to the transitive sense in entry 23074.
Form X evaluative usage is represented.
Synonymic and plural cross-reference without an additional meaning.
Inferior refuse and lower portion meaning is represented.
Quran-attested أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ construction and its interpretation are represented.
The passive participial result is covered by the transitive making or judging sense.

cautions: Lane's printed citation of the أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ expression includes xvi.72, which does not match the supplied QAC occurrence at 16:70; the citation is retained as lexical evidence and is not converted into a modern location.
